title: Renox runtime ops, contract version 1.5.0
description: One op call as JSON: {op, args, result} or {op, args, error}; or one page dispatch (ops.md section 14): {dispatch: "page", invocation, result}; or, from 1.3.0, the bootstrap init with the module list (section 11, step 3): {dispatch: "init", modules}, or one event delivery (section 15.4): {dispatch: "event", envelope, result}. bigint and Uint8Array use the $bigint and $bytes encodings. Source of truth for prose: ops.md. From 1.5.0 also one realtime handler run (section 18): {dispatch: "realtime", envelope, result}; one tool call (section 19): {dispatch: "tool", envelope, result}; one job attempt (section 20): {dispatch: "job", envelope, result}.

bigint.description: JSON encoding of a JavaScript bigint (decimal digits).

param.description: ops.md section 1, Parameters. NaN and Infinity cannot appear in JSON; they are rejected at runtime with RENOX_DB_PARAM.

error.description: ops.md section 0: the RenoxError every op rejects with.

policy.description: The deciding policy id in dev mode, null otherwise.

call_op_db_query.description: ops.md section 1; the fourth argument (module) is 1.3.0; the fifth (scope) is 1.5.0

call_op_db_query_one.description: ops.md section 1; the fourth argument (module) is 1.3.0; the fifth (scope) is 1.5.0

call_op_db_execute.description: ops.md section 1; the fourth argument (module) is 1.3.0; the fifth (scope) is 1.5.0

call_op_db_tx_commit.description: ops.md section 1; void is encoded as null

call_op_db_tx_rollback.description: ops.md section 1; void is encoded as null

call_op_secrets_get_all.description: ops.md section 3; the module argument is 1.3.0

call_op_log.description: ops.md section 4; never has an error; the fourth argument (module) is 1.3.0

call_op_response_write.description: ops.md section 6, "Response body" (1.2.0): one chunk of a streamed body; rejects with RENOX_NO_REQUEST once the stream was stopped

call_op_response_end.description: ops.md section 6, "Response body" (1.2.0): the end of a streamed body; null is the normal end, a string the message of the stream's failure; sync, never has an error

pageInvocation.description: ops.md section 14: Rust -> bootstrap for one page invocation.

module.description: 1.3.0: the installed module whose page it is; absent for the app's pages.

principal.description: 1.5.0: the request's principal (ops.md section 17), already past the page's guard; absent = anonymous.

data_json.description: JSON.stringify of the template data, a JSON object; at most 8 MiB proposed.

page_dispatch.description: ops.md section 14; not an op: Rust calls the bootstrap's dispatch function.

moduleName.description: An installed module's name (manifest.md MF1) or "app".

moduleArg.description: ops.md section 0, "Module" (1.3.0): the module an op acts for; null = the app.

call_op_db_savepoint_release.description: ops.md section 1, "Savepoints" (1.3.0); void is encoded as null

call_op_db_savepoint_rollback.description: ops.md section 1, "Savepoints" (1.3.0); rolls back to the savepoint, then releases it; void is encoded as null

call_op_events_emit.description: ops.md section 15.4 (1.3.0): name, payload as JSON text, durable, module, tx

prefixItems.description: JSON.stringify of the payload; at most 64 KiB.
1 to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; checked in bytes by the bootstrap.

result.description: PHC string with the platform parameters, 16-byte salt and 32-byte hash, unpadded base64.

call_op_password_verify.description: ops.md section 16 (1.3.0): a malformed or over-parameter hash resolves false

prefixItems.description: 1 to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; checked in bytes by the bootstrap.

moduleInfo.description: ops.md section 11, step 3 (1.3.0): one module as the bootstrap receives it, copied from the artifact's modules[] entry (artifact.md section 3, "Modules"): what the broker checks against.

bootstrap_init.description: ops.md section 11, step 3 (1.3.0); not an op: Rust passes the module list to the bootstrap's init function, in the artifact's modules order.

eventEnvelope.description: ops.md section 15.4, "Delivery": the cell -> bootstrap for one delivery attempt.

event_dispatch.description: ops.md section 15.4 (1.3.0); not an op: the cell calls the bootstrap's event function.

locale.description: 1.4.0 (ops.md section 14, "Locale"): a BCP 47 language tag as in 1.3.0, optionally followed by one Unicode extension -u- with the keys ca (calendar) and nu (numbering system) only, in that order, each at most once, values from the CLDR lists named in the contract. dir comes from the language subtag only. Absent = en.

authzAction.description: An authorization action of the merged action set, <resource>.<verb> (ops.md section 17; manifest.md [authz] actions).

roleName.description: A role name (ops.md section 17): a key of [authz.default_roles] or any role an assignment names.

scopeType.description: global, or the attrs key the assignment is scoped on (org).

principal.description: ops.md section 17, "Principal": the end user as the cell resolved it through auth.principal, or a System principal; null in the envelopes is the anonymous principal.

principalArg.description: ops.md section 17: the request's principal, null = anonymous.

scope.description: ops.md section 17, "db.scoped()": the scope of a scoped statement (the fifth argument of op_db_query, op_db_query_one, op_db_execute, 1.5.0).

resourceRef.description: ops.md section 17: a resource as tenant code passes it; type is a key of [authz.entities] (optionally <module>:<Type> from the app), id the entity id, the other keys its attributes (only the declared ones are kept).

authzContext.description: The caller's Cedar context; the platform keys mfa_verified, now and request are written over it.

decision.description: ops.md section 17: policy is the deciding policy id in dev mode, null otherwise.

call_op_authz_check.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): action, resource or null, context or null, module; the principal is the request's own

call_op_authz_check_batch.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): one boolean per resource, in order; at most 1,000 resources

call_op_authz_explain.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): dev mode only; in production it rejects with RENOX_FORBIDDEN, reason dev_only

call_op_authz_roles_assign.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): user_id, role, scope_type, scope_id, module, tx; writes renox__role_assignments in the current transaction and emits authz.roles_changed

call_op_authz_roles_revoke.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): same arguments as assign; true when a row was removed

call_op_authz_roles_list.description: ops.md section 17 (1.5.0): the assignments of a user

connId.description: ops.md section 18: the opaque id of a realtime connection of the same tenant.

sseEvent.description: The SSE event name; ignored on a WebSocket.

realtimePayload.description: ops.md section 18, "Payloads": what crosses after the bootstrap serialised ctx.realtime's payload. A message over 64 KB after rendering is RENOX_REALTIME_LIMIT.

template.description: A partial template id of the caller's module (artifact.md section 3), rendered by the cell.

call_op_realtime_subscribe.description: ops.md section 18 (1.5.0): the Cedar action realtime.subscribe on Renox::Topic, fail closed; a denied subscribe rejects with RENOX_FORBIDDEN

call_op_realtime_publish.description: ops.md section 18 (1.5.0): the result is the number of connections the message was queued for

call_op_realtime_send.description: ops.md section 18 (1.5.0): a full outbound queue rejects with RENOX_REALTIME_BACKPRESSURE and closes the connection

call_op_realtime_close.description: ops.md section 18 (1.5.0): a WebSocket close code (1000-4999) and an optional reason; for SSE the stream ends

realtimeEnvelope.description: ops.md section 18, "Dispatch": the cell -> bootstrap for one handler run (open, message, close) of a ws or sse connection.

module.description: 1.3.0: the installed module whose page it is; absent for the app's pages.

data.description: message only: the text or binary frame, at most 64 KB.

realtime_dispatch.description: ops.md section 18 (1.5.0); not an op: the cell calls the bootstrap's realtime function.

toolEnvelope.description: ops.md section 19, "Dispatch": the cell -> bootstrap for one tools/call that passed the token, scope, rate limit, input and Cedar checks.

module.description: 1.3.0: the installed module whose page it is; absent for the app's pages.

preview.description: true: the first call of a confirm tool; the run's transaction is rolled back.

toolResult.description: ops.md section 19: bootstrap -> cell; output_json is at most 256 KB.

tool_dispatch.description: ops.md section 19 (1.5.0); not an op: the cell calls the bootstrap's tool function.

call_op_jobs_enqueue.description: ops.md section 20 (1.5.0): name, payload as JSON text (at most 64 KiB), run_at (Unix ms or null), module, tx; the row is written in the current transaction

jobEnvelope.description: ops.md section 20, "Dispatch": the cell -> bootstrap for one attempt of a scheduled tick or a queued run.

tick.description: The tick the run is for (the latest missed one when ticks coalesced), or the run_at of a queued run.

payload.description: null for a scheduled run; the enqueued payload for a queued run.

job_dispatch.description: ops.md section 20 (1.5.0); not an op: the outbox worker calls the bootstrap's job function.

jobState.description: ops.md section 20 (1.6.0): the states `op_jobs_list` filters on.

jobRow.description: ops.md section 20 (1.6.0): one job row as the `jobs` module sees it. Never the payload; `last_error` is the redacted message of the last failed attempt.

call_op_jobs_list.description: ops.md section 20 (1.6.0): state, limit (1 to 100), cursor, module. Callable only by module `jobs`.

call_op_jobs_retry.description: ops.md section 20 (1.6.0): a dead letter goes back to the outbox with attempts reset. Module `jobs` only, in the current transaction.

call_op_jobs_cancel.description: ops.md section 20 (1.6.0): a queued or dead row is deleted. Module `jobs` only, in the current transaction.
